QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is only defined under `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` with a GNU-style or ARM compiler (`library/constant_time_impl.h:40-52`). The `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` gate is set in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:52`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says CT_ASM is defined under HAVE_ASM plus a compiler check, but it never says it is derived rather than configured. It also says the HAVE_ASM gate is set in the config header, which blurs the point.
